summary: The page meticulously follows the assigned brief and outline. It covers the four required subsections: metric-based scorecards, compliance gap and certificate reviews, formal status transition governance, and defensible audit evidence retention. All APG external provider guidance references and ICC Supplier Quality module features are accurately cited and framed with appropriate demonstration checkpoints and ISO 9001:2015 disclaimers. All required workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions, software evaluation tests, and labeled illustrative examples are present without unassigned FAQ sections.

glossary.definition: A quantitative evaluation tool compiling verified receiving inspection yields, PPM defect rates, delivery timeliness, and SCAR responsiveness into periodic supplier performance ratings.
A supervised governance tier applied to an external provider following quality or compliance slippage, imposing tightened inspection protocols and heightened managerial order approvals.
A controlled compilation of multi-year supplier evaluation records, audit reports, SCAR resolutions, and status authorizations assembled to demonstrate systematic control to external auditors.

roles: Chair of the supplier review committee
decisions: Assign monthly supplier performance scores and rating tiers based on receiving yields and SCAR cycle times
Determine whether supplier compliance deficiencies or certificate gaps require automated purchasing blocks or reminders
Downgrade chronic low-performing supplier from Approved to Probationary or Disqualified status
Evaluate completeness of historical supplier governance evidence package prior to third-party or customer audit
